paragraphs: The Company is a fully integrated REIT primarily focused on the ownership, acquisition, development and management of retail properties net leased to industry leading tenants. The Company was founded in 1971 by its current Executive Chairman, Richard Agree, and its common stock was listed on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") in 1994. The Company's assets are held by, and all of its operations are conducted through, directly or indirectly, the Operating Partnership of which the Company is the sole general partner and in which it held a 99.7% common interest as of December 31, 2025. Under the agreement of limited partnership of the Operating Partnership, the Company, as the sole general partner, has exclusive responsibility and discretion in the management and control of the Operating Partnership.

As of December 31, 2025, the Company's portfolio consisted of 2,674 properties located in all 50 states and totaling approximately 55.5 million square feet of Gross Leasable Area ("GLA"). The portfolio was approximately 99.7% leased and had a weighted average remaining lease term of approximately 7.8 years. A significant majority of the Company's properties are leased to national tenants and approximately 66.8% of our annualized base rent was derived from tenants, or parent entities thereof, with an investment grade credit rating from S&P Global Ratings, Moody's Investors Service, Fitch Ratings or the National Association of Insurance Commissioners. Substantially all of our tenants are subject to net lease agreements. A net lease typically requires the tenant to be responsible for minimum monthly rent and property operating expenses including property taxes, insurance and maintenance.

As of December 31, 2025, the Company had 90 full-time employees, covering accounting, acquisitions, asset management, development and construction, finance, information technology, legal, due diligence, and people and culture.

The Company was incorporated in December 1993 under the laws of the State of Maryland. The Company believes that it has operated, and it intends to continue to operate, in such a manner to qualify as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the "Internal Revenue Code"). In order to maintain qualification as a REIT, the Company must, among other things, distribute at least 90% of its REIT taxable income each year and meet asset and income tests. Additionally, its charter limits ownership of the Company, directly or constructively, by any single person to 9.8% of the value or number of shares, whichever is more restrictive, of its outstanding common stock and 9.8% of the value of the aggregate of all of its outstanding stock, subject to certain exceptions. As a REIT, the Company is not subject to federal income tax with respect to that portion of its income that is distributed currently to its stockholders.
The Company's principal executive offices are located at 32301 Woodward Avenue, Royal Oak, MI 48073 and its telephone number is (248) 737-4190. The Company's website is www.agreerealty.com.

For a discussion of business developments that occurred in 2025, see "Item 7 – Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" later in this report. Certain summarized highlights are contained below.

During 2025, the Company completed approximately $1.57 billion of investments in net leased retail real estate. Total investment volume includes the acquisition of 305 properties for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1.44 billion, and the completed development of 21 properties for an aggregate cost of approximately $131.2 million. These properties are net leased to tenants operating in 29 sectors and are located in 41 states. These assets are leased for a weighted average lease term of approximately 11.5 years.
During 2025, the Company sold 22 assets and land parcels for net proceeds of $42.1 million and recorded a net gain of $5.4 million.

During 2025, excluding properties that were sold, the Company executed new leases, extensions or options on approximately 3,033,000 square feet of GLA throughout its portfolio. The annualized base contractual rent associated with these new leases, extensions or options is approximately $29.7 million.
The Company increased its monthly dividend per common share from $0.253 to $0.256 in April 2025 and further increased the monthly dividend per common share to $0.262 in October 2025.

The December 2025 dividend per share of $0.262 represents an annualized dividend of $3.144 per share and an annualized dividend yield of approximately 4.4% based on the last reported sales price of our common stock listed on the NYSE of $72.03 on December 31, 2025.

The Company has routinely paid cash dividends to our common shareholders. Common cash dividends were paid quarterly for 107 consecutive quarters between 1994 and 2020 prior to moving to monthly common cash dividends in 2021. We have since paid 60 consecutive monthly dividends. Although we expect to continue our policy of paying regular dividends, we cannot guarantee that we will maintain our current level of common dividends, that we will continue our recent pattern of increasing dividends per share or what our actual dividend yield will be in any future period.
In addition to its common dividends, the Company paid monthly cash dividends on its 4.25% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock.

In April 2025, the Company completed a follow-on public offering of 5,175,000 shares of common stock, including the full exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase an additional 675,000 shares in connection with the forward sale agreements. As of December 31, 2025, the Company has not settled any of these shares. The offering is anticipated to raise net proceeds of approximately $385.8 million after deducting fees and expenses and making certain adjustments as provided in the forward sale agreements.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
Economic and financial conditions may have a negative effect on our business and operations.
Our business is significantly dependent on single tenant properties.
Bankruptcy laws will limit our remedies if a tenant becomes bankrupt and rejects its leases.
Our portfolio is concentrated in certain states, which makes us more susceptible to adverse events in these areas.
Our tenants are concentrated in certain retail sectors, which makes us susceptible to adverse conditions impacting these sectors.
There are risks associated with our development and acquisition activities.
Loss of revenues from tenants would reduce the Company's cash flow.
The availability and timing of cash dividends is uncertain.
We face risks relating to information technology and cybersecurity attacks, loss of confidential information and other business disruptions.
The use of artificial intelligence presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact our business and operating results or that of our tenants.
Our environmental, social and governance commitments could result in additional costs, and our inability to achieve them could have an adverse impact on our reputation and performance.
Our performance and value are subject to general economic conditions and risks associated with our real estate assets.
We face risks associated with climate change, which could materially and adversely impact us.
Compliance with the ADA, fire and safety regulations, and other regulations may require us to make unanticipated expenditures.
The fact that real estate investments are relatively illiquid may reduce economic returns to investors.
Our ability to renew leases or re-lease space on favorable terms as leases expire significantly affects our business.
Our leases contain certain limitations on tenants' real estate tax, insurance and operating cost reimbursement obligations.
Potential liability for environmental contamination could result in substantial costs.
Uninsured losses relating to real property may adversely affect our operating results and cash flows and upon renewal of our insurance policies, our coverage may change and our costs may increase.
Risks Related to Our Debt Financings
Covenants in our credit agreements and note purchase agreements could limit our flexibility and adversely affect our financial condition.
Our hedging strategies may not be successful in mitigating our risks associated with interest rates and could reduce the overall returns on your investment.
Future offerings of debt and equity may not be available to us or may adversely affect the market price of our common stock.
Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure
Our charter, bylaws and Maryland law contain provisions that may delay, defer or prevent a change of control transaction.
An officer and director may have interests that conflict with the interests of stockholders.
Complying with REIT requirements may cause us to forego otherwise attractive opportunities.
Failure to qualify as a REIT could adversely affect our operations and our ability to make distributions.
Changes in tax laws may prevent us from maintaining our qualification as a REIT.
Complying with REIT requirements may force us to liquidate or restructure otherwise attractive investments.
We may have to borrow funds or sell assets to meet our distribution requirements.
Our ownership of and relationship with our TRSs will be limited, and a failure to comply with the limits would jeopardize our REIT status and may result in the application of a 100% excise tax.
Liquidation of our assets may jeopardize our REIT qualification.
We may be subject to other tax liabilities even if we qualify as a REIT.
paragraphs: The following factors and other factors discussed in this Annual Report on Form 10-K could cause the Company's actual results to differ materially from those contained in forward-looking statements made in this report or presented elsewhere in future SEC reports. You should carefully consider each of the risks, assumptions, uncertainties and other factors described below and elsewhere in this report, as well as any reports, amendments or updates reflected in subsequent filings or furnishings with the SEC. We believe these risks, assumptions, uncertainties and other factors, individually or in the aggregate, could cause our actual results to differ materially from expected and historical results and could materially and adversely affect our business operations, results of operations, financial condition and liquidity.

Changes in global or national economic conditions, such as the global economic and financial market downturn, rising tensions between China and Taiwan and the conflicts in Ukraine and in the Middle East, may cause or continue to cause, among other things, tightening in the credit markets, lower levels of liquidity, increases in the rate of default and bankruptcy and lower consumer spending and business spending, which could adversely affect our business and operations.

For example, the current and continued macro-economic conditions of elevated inflation and increased interest rates have increased the costs associated with acquiring new properties and decreased the availability of financing on terms that we find acceptable, which has reduced our ability to acquire properties at our historical rate with attractive terms. Potential consequences of changes in economic and financial conditions include:
•Changes in the performance of our tenants, which may result in lower rent and lower recoverable expenses that the tenant can afford to pay and tenant defaults under the leases;
•Current or potential tenants may delay or postpone entering into long-term net leases with us;

•The ability to borrow on terms and conditions that we find acceptable may be limited or unavailable, which could reduce our ability to pursue acquisition and development opportunities and refinance existing debt, reduce our returns from acquisition and development activities, reduce our ability to make cash distributions to our stockholders and increase our future interest expense;

paragraphs: 本公司為一間完全整合的REIT，主要從事零售不動產的所有權、取得、開發及管理，這些不動產以淨租賃方式出租給業界領導租戶。本公司於1971年由現任執行主席Richard Agree創立，並於1994年在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）上市。本公司資產由，且所有營運活動均透過，直接或間接，運營合夥企業進行，而本公司為該運營合夥企業的唯一普通合夥人，截至2025年12月31日，本公司持有該運營合夥企業99.7%的普通權益。根據運營合夥企業的有限合夥協議，本公司作為唯一普通合夥人，擁有對運營合夥企業管理與控制的獨家責任與裁量權。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司資產組合包含 2,674 處不動產，分佈於美國所有 50 個州，總計約 55.5 百萬平方英呎的毛可出租面積（"GLA"）。該資產組合出租率約為 99.7%，加權平均剩餘租期約為 7.8 年。本公司絕大多數不動產出租予全國性租戶，約 66.8% 的年度基本租金來自具投資等級信用評等之租戶，或其母公司，該信用評等由 S&P Global Ratings、Moody's Investors Service、Fitch Ratings 或 National Association of Insurance Commissioners 評定。本公司幾乎所有租戶均受淨租賃契約約束。淨租賃通常要求租戶負擔最低月租金及不動產營運費用，包括地價稅、保險及維護費用。
截至2025年12月31日，本公司共有90名全職員工，涵蓋會計、取得、資產管理、開發與建設、財務、資訊科技、法律、盡職調查及人力與文化等部門。

本公司於1993年12月根據馬裏蘭州法律註冊成立。本公司認為其已運作，並有意繼續運作，符合1986年內幕收入法典（"內幕收入法典"）所規定的REIT條件。為維持REIT資格，本公司必須每年至少分派90%的REIT應稅所得，並符合資產與收入測試。此外，本公司章程限制任何個人直接或間接持有本公司已發行普通股的價值或數量，不得超過9.8%， whichever is more restrictive，以及所有已發行股票價值的9.8%。作為REIT，本公司就其分派給股東的所得部分，不需繳納聯邦所得稅。
本公司主要營業處所位於 32301 Woodward Avenue, Royal Oak, MI 48073，電話號碼為 (248) 737-4190。本公司網站為 www.agreerealty.com。
有關2025年業務發展的討論，請參閱本報告後續的"項目7 – 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析"。以下為部分重點摘要。
2025年，本公司完成約15.7億美元的淨租賃零售不動產投資。總投資金額包括以約14.4億美元購入305處不動產，以及以約1.312億美元完成21處不動產的開發。這些不動產出租給經營於29個產業的租戶，分佈於41個州。這些資產的租約加權平均期間約為11.5年。
2025 年間，本公司出售 22 處資產及土地，淨收入為 42.1 百萬美元，並計入淨獲利 5.4 百萬美元。
2025 年，扣除已出售的不動產後，本公司於其資產組閤中執行了約 3,033,000 平方英呎的 GLA 新租約、續約或選項。與這些新租約、續約或選項相關的年度基礎契約租金約為 2,970 萬美元。
本公司於 2025 年 4 月將普通股每月股息從 0.253 美元提高至 0.256 美元，並於 2025 年 10 月進一步將普通股每月股息提高至 0.262 美元。
2025 年 12 月每股 0.262 美元的股息，代表每股年化股息為 3.144 美元，年化股息報酬率約為 4.4%，基於 2025 年 12 月 31 日本公司普通股在紐約證券交易所最後報導的銷售價格 72.03 美元計算。

除了普通股股息外，本公司已 routinely 支付現金股息給普通股股東。1994 年至 2020 年間，本公司已連續 107 季度支付普通股現金股息，於 2021 年轉為每月支付普通股現金股息。自那之後，本公司已連續支付 60 個月的現金股息。儘管本公司預期會繼續執行支付定期股息的政策，但本公司無法保證會維持目前的普通股股息水準，或會繼續最近的每股股息增加模式，或未來任何期間的實際股息報酬率為何。
除了其普通股股息外，本公司亦支付每月現金股息於其 4.25% 系列 A 累積可贖回優先股。
2025 年 4 月，本公司完成一項追加公開發行，發行 5,175,000 股普通股，包括發行人在前售協議中行使選擇權購買額外 675,000 股。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司尚未兌現這些股份。預期此次發行將籌得淨資金約 3.858 億美元，扣除費用及開支並根據前售協議進行某些調整後。

paragraphs: 以下討論應配合本年度報告表 10-K 所附之合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及「風險因素」項目 1A 中的「前瞻性陳述警示」一併閱讀。另請參閱本公司於 2024 年 12 月 31 日結算年度所提交之年度報告表 10-K 中的「項目 7 – 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」，以取得更多關於本公司財務狀況與營運成果之討論，包括 2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日結算年度之營運成果比較。

本公司為一完整整合之 REIT，主要從事零售不動產之擁有、取得、開發與管理，出租予業界領導租戶。本公司於 1971 年由現任執行董事長 Richard Agree 資助設立，並於 1994 年在紐約證券交易所上市。本公司之資產由，且所有營運活動均透過直接或間接之營運合夥企業進行，本公司為該營運合夥企業之唯一普通合夥人，且截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司持有該營運合夥企業 99.7% 之普通權益。請參閱本表 10-K 所附合併財務報表附註中之附註 1 – 組織結構，以取得更多有關股權結構之資訊。根據營運合夥企業之有限合夥協議，本公司作為唯一普通合夥人，擁有營運合夥企業之管理與控制之獨家責任與裁量權。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司的資產組合包含位於美國50州的2,674處不動產，總計約55.5百萬平方英呎的總樓地板面積（GLA）。該資產組合約99.7%已出租，加權平均剩餘租約期間約為7.8年。本公司的大部分不動產出租給全國性租戶，約66.8%的年度基本租金來自租戶或其母公司，這些租戶或母公司擁有S&P Global Ratings、Moody's Investors Service、Fitch Ratings或國家保險委員會（National Association of Insurance Commissioners）所評定的投資等級信用評分。淨租賃通常要求租戶負擔最低月租金及不動產營運費用，包括地稅、保險及維護費用。
本公司自 1994 年 12 月 31 日結算年度起，已選擇以 REIT 之形式納入美國聯邦所得稅課稅。本公司認為其組織與營運方式已使其符合美國聯邦所得稅之 REIT 資格，並有意持續以該方式營運。

本公司的不動產投資組合從2024年12月31日約7.42十億美元的淨投資金額，代表2,370處不動產及48.8百萬平方英呎的總樓地板面積（GLA），成長至2025年12月31日約8.57十億美元的淨投資金額，代表2,674處不動產及55.5百萬平方英呎的總樓地板面積（GLA）。本公司的不動產投資於所列期間內及期間之間進行，並非全部於整個期間內持續存在；因此，租賃收入在期間之間的增加部分，與2024年完成的收購、開發及DFP專案在2025年認列收入有關。同樣地，2025年進行的收購所產生的全部租賃收入影響，將要到2026年才能看到。

headings: 與本公司業務及營運相關之風險
總體經濟與財務狀況可能對本公司業務及營運產生負面影響。
本公司業務嚴重依賴單一租戶大樓。
破產法將限制本公司在租戶破產且拒絕履行租約時之救濟措施。
本公司資產組成集中於某些州，使本公司更易受這些地區不利事件之影響。
本公司租戶集中於某些零售業種，使本公司易受這些業種不利狀況之影響。

租戶收入減少將降低本公司之現金流。
現金股息的發放時機與可得性存在不確定性。
我們面臨與資訊科技及網路安全攻擊、機密資訊外洩及其他業務中斷相關的風險。
人工智慧的應用可能帶來風險與挑戰，可能對我們的業務與營運成果，或我們租戶的業務與營運成果產生不利影響。

paragraphs: 下列因素及其他在本年度報告表10-K中討論的因素，可能會導致本公司的實際結果與本報告或未來SEC報告中所作的預測性陳述有重大差異。您應仔細考慮下列及本報告其他部分所描述的風險、假設、不確定性及其他因素，以及任何在後續申報文件或提交給SEC的補充資料或更新資訊。我們認為這些風險、假設、不確定性及其他因素，無論個別或整體，都可能導致我們的實際結果與預期及歷史結果有重大差異，並可能對我們的業務運作、營運結果、財務狀況及流動性產生重大且不利的影響。
全球或國家經濟條件的變化，例如全球經濟與金融市場衰退、中國與臺灣之間的緊張關係升高以及烏克蘭與中東地區的衝突，可能會導致或繼續導致信貸市場收縮、流動性水準降低、違約與破產率增加以及消費者與企業支出減少，這可能會對我們的業務與運作產生不利影響。
例如，目前及持續的總體經濟條件，即通貨膨脹升高與利率增加，已提高取得新不動產的相關成本，並降低在我們認為可接受的條件下取得融資的可得性，這已降低我們以有吸引力的條件取得不動產的能力，與歷史速度相比。經濟與金融條件變化的潛在後果包括：
•我們租戶的營運表現變化，可能會導致租金減少以及租戶無法負擔的可回收費用減少，並導致租賃契約下的租戶違約；
•現有或潛在租戶可能延後或擱置與我們簽訂長期淨租賃契約；
•我們可能無法在我們認為可接受的條件下取得貸款，這可能會限制或完全無法取得貸款，進而降低我們追求取得與開發機會及重組現有債務的能力，降低我們從取得與開發活動中獲得的回報，降低我們向股東發放現金分紅的能力，並增加我們未來的利息支出。
